blocks.text: SpaceX今日财报电话会议的主要要点

inlines.text: SpaceX今日财报电话会议的主要要点

blocks.text: AI现在是SpaceX最大的业务：超级智能部门向包括Anthropic和Google在内的客户出租算力，带来了76亿美元收入，几乎是第二季度25.6亿美元的三倍。
这使其成为SpaceX最大的收入来源，超过了52亿美元的Starlink连接业务，其中6.08亿美元来自新收购的Cursor。

inlines.text: 这使其成为SpaceX最大的收入来源，超过了52亿美元的Starlink连接业务，其中6.08亿美元来自新收购的Cursor。

blocks.text: SpaceX扭亏为盈：净利润达到44亿美元，营收为146亿美元，增长161%，而一年前亏损11亿美元，第二季度亏损5.41亿美元。尽管如此，SpaceX在2026年前9个月仍显示净亏损4.13亿美元。
SpaceX与Tesla的合并正在研究中：两家公司的独立董事委员会应股东要求正在讨论合并事宜，Musk表示，作为存在利益冲突的一方，他被排除在这些谈判之外。他称合并是个好主意，但表示并不确定，任何交易都需要获得所有已发行Tesla股份的多数支持。
Musk预计收入将成倍增长：Musk预测到2027年底，年度经常性收入将达到5000亿至1万亿美元。SpaceX自身的近期指引则低得多，基于12月销售额，预计到2026年底年化收入为1000亿美元，2027年第一季度收入为330亿至370亿美元。
支出超过收入：第三季度资本支出达到196亿美元，其中164亿美元用于AI部门，SpaceX预计第四季度为350亿至400亿美元。Musk表示，SpaceX更倾向于短期算力合同，因为他预计随着AI模型改进，每瓦算力将带来更多收益。
Musk在孟菲斯工作：Musk表示，他经常每周在孟菲斯待4天，让Colossus II超级计算机上线，因为SpaceX每月增加约20万块Nvidia GB300芯片。截至9月底，算力容量为1.7GW，SpaceX预计到年底将达到2.5GW至3GW，Musk表示他有信心在2027年增加10GW。
路易斯安那州发射预计在2029年前实现：SpaceX最近宣布计划在路易斯安那州建设一座耗资1000亿美元的航天港，Musk表示内部目标是在两年内实现首次发射，而2029年极有可能，当年将实现规模化发射。
Main takeaways from SpaceX’s earnings call today

inlines.text: Main takeaways from SpaceX’s earnings call today

blocks.text: AI is now SpaceX’s biggest business: The Super Intelligence segment, which rents computing capacity to customers including Anthropic and Google, brought in $7.6B, nearly triple its $2.56B in the second quarter.
That made it SpaceX’s largest revenue source, ahead of the $5.2B Starlink connectivity business, with $608M coming from the newly acquired Cursor.

inlines.text: That made it SpaceX’s largest revenue source, ahead of the $5.2B Starlink connectivity business, with $608M coming from the newly acquired Cursor.

blocks.text: SpaceX swung to a profit: Net income reached $4.4B on $14.6B of revenue, up 161%, against a $1.1B loss a year earlier and a $541M loss in the second quarter. Even so, SpaceX still showed a $413M net loss for the first 9 months of 2026.

A SpaceX-Tesla merger is under study: Committees of independent directors at both companies are discussing a combination at shareholders’ request, and Musk said he is excluded from those talks as a conflicted party. He called a merger a good idea but said it isn’t certain, and any deal would need support from a majority of all outstanding Tesla shares.

Musk sees revenue multiplying: Musk projected annual recurring revenue of $500B to $1T by the end of 2027. SpaceX’s own guidance is far lower in the near term, with $100B in annualized revenue by the end of 2026, based on December sales, and $33B to $37B of revenue in the first quarter of 2027.

Spending is outrunning revenue: Capital spending hit $19.6B in the third quarter, $16.4B of it in the AI segment, and SpaceX expects $35B to $40B in the fourth quarter. Musk said SpaceX prefers short-term compute contracts because he expects each watt of computing to earn more as AI models improve.

Musk is working from Memphis: Musk said he often spends 4 days a week in Memphis bringing the Colossus II supercomputer online, as SpaceX adds roughly 200K Nvidia GB300 chips a month. Compute capacity stood at 1.7GW at the end of September, SpaceX expects 2.5GW to 3GW by year-end, and Musk said he is confident of adding 10GW during 2027.

Louisiana launches are expected by 2029: SpaceX recently announced plans for a $100B spaceport in Louisiana, and Musk said the internal goal is a first launch there within 2 years, while 2029 is highly likely, with launches at scale that year.
